metadata.description: Claude Code and Codex plugins that work together: a Codex bridge, a plan-and-run loop, a pre-merge audit, code review skills, and repo instruction docs.

plugins.name: ccx
plugins.description: Hand a task to the Codex CLI, run it once, and print what it said. Also keeps a block of house rules in your CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: ccx-loop
plugins.description: Run a tiered plan, review, implement, review, publish loop for one unit of work, with Claude orchestrating, Codex implementing, and Codex or Claude reviewing.

plugins.name: cca
plugins.description: Audit a finished bundle of pull requests, in one or many repos, before merge: adversarial, evidence-gated review stages that stay read-only and end in a report, plus a gated command that acts on approved items.

plugins.name: repo-docs
plugins.description: Keeps a repository's instruction files correct and progressively disclosed.
